scope: Finite declared catalog; not exhaustive over all programs, inputs, interleavings, threats or deployments.

requirements.description: Only the exact next sequence and verified predecessor may commit.
Verify committed content and intended routing before every effect.
Integrity failures quarantine, clear context, and prevent effects.
Bound queue, payload bytes, session count, and immutable record admission.
Availability failure yields HOLD without granting trust or alleging tampering.
Diagnostic eviction never removes committed verification identities.
Capture immutable verified inputs before any suspension.
Apply bounded stream backpressure and own source cleanup without effect retries.
Shutdown and cancellation have one cleanup owner and settle resources.
Enforce explicit structural and semantic branch complexity budgets.
Validate the actual MCP wire contract without numeric coercion.
Measure speed and memory under declared environment-scoped budgets.
Retain reproducible assertions, failures, and requirement-preserving supersession.

invariants.description: Every input byte appears once at its original byte offset.
Packet splits do not change cuts or the independent polynomial oracle.
Sequence gaps, duplicate commits and incorrect parents never advance the ledger.
Committed block identity binds routing, source, session and predecessor.
Only a committed matching payload can cross the invocation gate.
Integrity mismatch clears context and causes zero additional effects.
Unavailable or interrupted verification cannot return trust.
Count and encoded-byte admission remain within configured bounds.
Unknown/evicted receipt grants no trust; ledger identities remain available.
An input mutation during await cannot replace bytes delivered to the tool.
Concurrent shutdown has one owner; pending bookkeeping reaches zero.
An expired transaction cannot commit or be classified as tampering.
Streaming preserves bytes with bounded staging and closes its source.
A failed effect sink is invoked once; siblings cancel and source closes.
Malformed core/wire frames are rejected before immutable admission.
Runtime modules <=180 lines, functions <=60, decision nesting <=5, AST branch proxy <=20.
Scanner/ledger speed and memory satisfy explicit local catastrophic-regression ceilings.
Every finite Cartesian tuple and declared requirement retains referentially valid, source-bound assertion links.

gates.description: Rolling polynomial, min/max boundary and byte-carving gate.
Strict sequence, parent, payload assertion and append gate.
Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.
Queue-count, pending-byte and immutable-ledger reservation gate.
Verifier availability checked both before and after hash work.
Bounded receipt/event observations separate from immutable records.
Immutable incoming snapshot before verification await.
Shared shielded shutdown task and cancellation cleanup.
Absolute transaction deadline checked before and after hashing.
Bounded staging, structured sibling cancellation and source close.
Strict scalar parsing in core and real MCP stdio.
Executable structural, local speed and memory budgets.
Relational completeness, foreign keys and production source provenance gate.

obligations.rationale: Dropped/reordered bytes at a chunk boundary. Every input byte appears once at its original byte offset. Owner: Rolling polynomial, min/max boundary and byte-carving gate.
Packet-size dependent cuts or incorrect polynomial. Packet splits do not change cuts or the independent polynomial oracle. Owner: Rolling polynomial, min/max boundary and byte-carving gate.
Positive control: valid committed handoff. Only a committed matching payload can cross the invocation gate. Owner: Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.
Wrong verified predecessor. Sequence gaps, duplicate commits and incorrect parents never advance the ledger. Owner: Strict sequence, parent, payload assertion and append gate.
Missing sequence predecessor. Sequence gaps, duplicate commits and incorrect parents never advance the ledger. Owner: Strict sequence, parent, payload assertion and append gate.
Duplicate commit attempt. Sequence gaps, duplicate commits and incorrect parents never advance the ledger. Owner: Strict sequence, parent, payload assertion and append gate.
Payload digest assertion differs at commit. Integrity mismatch clears context and causes zero additional effects. Owner: Strict sequence, parent, payload assertion and append gate.
Changed payload at invocation boundary. Integrity mismatch clears context and causes zero additional effects. Owner: Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.

Rewritten source metadata with unchanged payload. Committed block identity binds routing, source, session and predecessor. Owner: Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.
Recipient rewrite. Committed block identity binds routing, source, session and predecessor. Owner: Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.
Cross-session handoff substitution. Committed block identity binds routing, source, session and predecessor. Owner: Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.
Unregistered block identity. Committed block identity binds routing, source, session and predecessor. Owner: Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.
Self-claimed unregistered content hash. Only a committed matching payload can cross the invocation gate. Owner: Registered payload and metadata verification immediately before invocation.
Verifier invoked after engine shutdown. Unavailable or interrupted verification cannot return trust. Owner: Verifier availability checked both before and after hash work.
Availability changes across hashing await. Unavailable or interrupted verification cannot return trust. Owner: Verifier availability checked both before and after hash work.
Unexpected verifier exception. Unavailable or interrupted verification cannot return trust. Owner: Verifier availability checked both before and after hash work.
Concurrent verification exceeds admission cap. Unavailable or interrupted verification cannot return trust. Owner: Verifier availability checked both before and after hash work.
Inbound verification cancelled while suspended. Unavailable or interrupted verification cannot return trust. Owner: Shared shielded shutdown task and cancellation cleanup.
Queue count at cap plus one. Count and encoded-byte admission remain within configured bounds. Owner: Queue-count, pending-byte and immutable-ledger reservation gate.
Pending UTF-8 bytes at cap plus one. Count and encoded-byte admission remain within configured bounds. Owner: Queue-count, pending-byte and immutable-ledger reservation gate.
Immutable record reservation exceeds cap. Count and encoded-byte admission remain within configured bounds. Owner: Queue-count, pending-byte and immutable-ledger reservation gate.
Completed receipt evicted from bounded cache. Unknown/evicted receipt grants no trust; ledger identities remain available. Owner: Bounded receipt/event observations separate from immutable records.
Caller mutates payload while verification is suspended. An input mutation during await cannot replace bytes delivered to the tool. Owner: Immutable incoming snapshot before verification await.
Eight simultaneous shutdown callers. Concurrent shutdown has one owner; pending bookkeeping reaches zero. Owner: Shared shielded shutdown task and cancellation cleanup.
Queued work passes its absolute deadline. An expired transaction cannot commit or be classified as tampering. Owner: Absolute transaction deadline checked before and after hashing.
Positive control: byte stream under sink backpressure. Streaming preserves bytes with bounded staging and closes its source. Owner: Bounded staging, structured sibling cancellation and source close.
Sink failure with unknown effect outcome. A failed effect sink is invoked once; siblings cancel and source closes. Owner: Bounded staging, structured sibling cancellation and source close.
Malformed types, identifiers, digest or Unicode. Malformed core/wire frames are rejected before immutable admission. Owner: Strict scalar parsing in core and real MCP stdio.
MCP schema coercion, unregistered hash and tampered handoff. Malformed core/wire frames are rejected before immutable admission. Owner: Strict scalar parsing in core and real MCP stdio.
